svg.aria-label: Who I am: I'm technical and hands-on: recent builds include multi-agent AI systems with persistent memory, LLM evaluation and drift-testing harnesses, and governed demo pipelines, written in Go, Python, and Swift, plus NVIDIA NIM deployed on Kubernetes. I design where model judgment ends and deterministic code takes over, then prove it with paired evals and cost models before a buyer commits.
